snowmobile-trails.geojson.query: where 1=1, geometry = WBD HUC8 07010102 polygon, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects
snowmobile-trails.geojson.caveats: DNR Snowmobile Trails service, state + Grant-in-Aid trails (owner_type distinguishes them; see counts). No contact fields pulled (public_poc / public_pho / pocemail excluded, same as the ITM pull); pocwebsite (public club/org URL) is carried. Geometries are clipped to the HUC8 boundary, so a trail crossing the boundary is cut; the `miles` field is the FULL segment length and can exceed the drawn clipped length. Feature count matches the live returnCountOnly count.
